text:
let us say you won the race

and that the prize

was another race,

that you did not drink the wine of victory

but your own salt,

that you never heard cheers

but dogs barking,

and that your shadow,

your own shadow,

was your only

and disloyal competitor.

translation.title: Curriculum Vitae
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the mock-biographical structure and the self as disloyal rival.
